ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)
module_role: Air-interface contactless identification protocol stack between a Proximity Coupling Device (PCD reader) and one or more Proximity Integrated Circuits (PICCs) within a single 13.56 MHz RF field. Defines air carrier (Layer 2), anti-collision and selection (Layer 3), and block transmission protocol (Layer 4). On the PCD side a dedicated reader chip (e.g. NXP CLRC663 / PN5180 / PN512 / MFRC522) implements Layer 2/3/4 with a host bus (SPI / I2C / UART / parallel) and an antenna driver + matching network. On the PICC side an embedded SoC implements Layer 2 modulator + Layer 3 anti-collision + Layer 4 T=CL + application protocol (MIFARE Classic / Plus / DESFire / Ultralight / NTAG) on a single die behind a 2-pin (LA/LB) antenna.

integration_overview.host_bus_to_pcd_chip: SPI (most common) / I2C / UART / parallel — vendor-specific
integration_overview.no_chip_select_air_interface: Air interface has no chip-select; addressing is by UID (Layer 3) or CID (Layer 4).
integration_overview.controller_role: PCD is master and field generator; PICC is field-powered slave.
integration_overview.no_handshake_per_bit: Bit-level framing via SOF + parity (Type A) or SOF + EGT (Type B) + CRC. Flow control above is via FWT (Layer 4) and S(WTX).

interface_categories: RF Air Interface (single 13.56 MHz inductively-coupled channel)
PICC antenna terminals (LA, LB) — passive coil + tuning capacitor on tag side
PCD antenna driver pair (TX1, TX2) + matching network + receive path (RX, VMID)
PCD host bus (SPI / I2C / UART / parallel) to embedded MCU or AP
PCD interrupt line (IRQ) and reset / power-down (NRSTPD)
PCD crystal oscillator (typical 27.12 MHz — 2× carrier — for low-jitter synthesis)
interconnect_topologies_supported: Single PCD + single PICC — most common case (door access, ticket validator)
Single PCD + multiple PICCs in field — anti-collision required; PCD enumerates and HALTs each in turn
Single PCD + Type A and Type B PICCs in field — PCD must alternate REQA and REQB polls
Stacked / co-located PCDs — only one PCD field active at a time within the operating volume (otherwise field collision); coordination via host or RF-detect carrier-sense
NFC peer-to-peer (P2P) — strictly out of ISO 14443 scope (NFC-DEP per NFCIP-1 / ISO/IEC 18092 / ECMA-340)
default_signal_values_when_omitted: PCD's antenna driver is push-pull through the matching network when transmitting; receive path operates concurrently for load-modulation detection. PICC antenna terminals are passive — only the chip's internal rectifier + load-modulation FET interact with the resonant tank.
soc_dependent_items: PCD reader chip (CLRC663 / PN5180 / PN512 / MFRC522 / TRF7970A) selection determines maximum supported bit rates, anti-collision throughput, and host-bus options
Antenna geometry + Q-tuning matching network (per ISO 10373-6 antenna class — Class 1 ≈ 70 × 50 mm)
EMC filter on antenna driver (LCL low-pass) to suppress harmonics above 30 MHz
ESD protection on antenna terminals (Class 3B per IEC 61000-4-2)
Crystal source (typical 27.12 MHz) for low-phase-noise carrier synthesis
Host MCU / AP running NFC stack (libnfc, NFC Forum NCI, etc.) above the PCD chip
Optional secure element (SE) for payment / authentication application above T=CL

pull_up_resistors.purpose: Idle bus HIGH per host-bus convention.
Level-triggered active LOW or HIGH per chip.

low_power_modes.PCD_carrier_off: Maximum power saving — antenna driver idle, no field, all PICCs out of field state.
low_power_modes.PCD_doze_mode: Chip-specific low-power state with reduced polling cadence between REQA / REQB.
low_power_modes.PICC_field_off: Total loss of VCC; no PICC state retained.
low_power_modes.T_CL_S_DESELECT: Layer 4: PCD instructs PICC to drop from T_CL_ACTIVE to HALT — saves PICC die-internal current.

compatibility_notes: Type A and Type B PICCs share the same 13.56 MHz carrier but use different modulation / coding — PCD must alternate REQA and REQB to detect both.
MIFARE Classic family (and MIFARE Plus in SL1) sits above Layer 3 with a proprietary Crypto1-authenticated command set — they never advertise SAK bit 6 = 1 and never accept RATS.
MIFARE DESFire family (and Plus SL2/SL3) advertises SAK bit 6 = 1 and runs entirely above T=CL with APDU semantics.
MIFARE Ultralight / NTAG21x are NFC Forum Type 2 tags — Layer 3 + simple READ/WRITE; no T=CL, no Crypto1.
Modern reader chips (CLRC663 plus, PN5180) support Type A + Type B + ISO 15693 + ISO 18092 + EMVCo + NFC Forum simultaneously; older chips (MFRC522) are Type A 106 kbps only.
All MIFARE ICs are compliant to ISO/IEC 14443 part 2 (Layer 2) and part 3 (Layer 3); Part 4 (T=CL) is optional and used by DESFire / Plus SL2-SL3 / Ultralight C (with restrictions).
